fact: A day on Venus is longer than a year on Venus.
detail: Venus rotates so slowly that one rotation takes about 243 Earth days, while one trip around the Sun takes about 225 Earth days.
Two hearts send blood toward the gills, while the third sends blood around the rest of the body.

fact: Lightning can heat air to temperatures hotter than the surface of the Sun.
detail: A lightning channel can briefly reach roughly 30,000 kelvin, making the surrounding air expand extremely quickly.

fact: Some turtles can breathe through specialized tissue near their rear end.
detail: Certain freshwater turtles can absorb oxygen through highly vascularized tissue while underwater.

fact: On Mercury, one solar day lasts longer than its year.
detail: Mercury rotates three times for every two orbits, so sunrise-to-sunrise takes about 176 Earth days while its year is about 88 days.
Bone is constantly remodeled by specialized cells that remove old tissue and build new tissue.

fact: Crows can remember individual human faces.
detail: Research has shown that crows can learn to recognize particular human faces and remember them for long periods.

fact: There are underwater lakes on the seafloor.
detail: Very salty brine can pool in depressions on the ocean floor, creating lake-like bodies beneath seawater.
